study.name: Retest: Phase 3a: H3 Consensus Voting — Track 1 (Image, HIGH Thinking)
study.description:
Tests consensus voting with HIGH thinking level at elevated temperatures (T=0.3, T=0.7, T=1.0) using the carry-forward plus-hp library configuration with HIGH thinking enabled.
Motivated by the Phase 3a replication finding that HIGH thinking + consensus voting at T=0.7 achieves F1=0.771 on the text track — the best result in the study. This experiment tests whether the same effect holds on the image track and at other temperatures.
HIGH thinking produces more false positives per run (lower single-pass precision) but the false positives are stochastic while true positives are consistent, enabling consensus voting to filter effectively.
study.retest_notes: H3 consensus voting Track 1 (image-using) with HIGH thinking. K=30 for full threshold sweep. New experiment — the pilot's 'track1-image-high' was mislabelled (actually used minimal thinking).
